text: Did the testicular pain start suddenly and severely, within minutes to a few hours?
Is the testicular pain accompanied by nausea or vomiting?
Does the affected testicle appear higher, or lie horizontally, compared to the other side?
Is there fever along with the testicular pain or swelling?
Is there a painless lump or hard area felt in the testicle?
Did the pain begin right after a direct injury or trauma to the groin or testicle?
Has an erection lasted longer than 4 hours, with or without sexual stimulation?
Did the erectile difficulty begin shortly after starting a new medication?
Has the patient had prostate surgery (radical or simple prostatectomy) in the past?
Has the patient had bladder removal surgery (radical cystectomy) in the past?
Has the patient had prior urethral surgery or repeated urethral catheterization?
Does the erectile difficulty occur only in certain situations (for example, normal erections during sleep or masturbation but not with a partner)?
